text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容與期限以 Bybit 官方公告為準。
text.en: Taken from the platform's share text; actual terms follow Bybit's official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: 註冊 Bybit 帳號，參加推薦計畫並領取專屬獎勵。
intro.en: Sign up for a Bybit account and claim exclusive rewards from the Bybit referral program.

description.zh-TW: Bybit 是加密貨幣交易所，也設有推薦計畫。這個邀請連結已經包含邀請碼 9QJMRD；進入註冊頁後，若有推薦碼欄位而且是空的，請自行填入這組代碼。平台分享文案提到最高 500 USDT 的獎勵，實際內容與期限以 Bybit 官方公告為準。註冊前先確認網址列的網域與官方網站一致，再填寫個人資料。
description.en:
Bybit is a crypto exchange with a referral program. The referral link on this page already contains the referral code 9QJMRD. Once the sign-up page opens, check whether it has a referral code field; if the field is empty, type the code in yourself.

The platform's share text mentions a bonus of up to 500 USDT. Actual terms follow Bybit's official announcements. Before you enter personal details, confirm that the domain in the address bar matches Bybit's official website.
